cases.question: German AX-17 guidance before latest revision?
cases.answer:
Part 1
Historical view: documents in effect on 2026-09-15.

I don't have this in the controlled documents (the specific guidance and details of the previous German AX-17 label (DE-AX17-LBL-038)). The documents cover AX-17 labels, safety bulletins, clinical studies and safety letters for Germany, Singapore, UAE, United States. Say "route it" and I'll pass the question to Medical Information.
